run_when: QuickBooks was mentioned on the site or in job posts.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company itself currently uses QuickBooks Online for its own books.
prompt.definition: Rarely visible; when it is, it is decisive.
yes_when: A job post asks for QuickBooks experience for the company's own finance or ops work
The company says it uses QuickBooks
no_when: The company says it uses a different accounting system
unknown_when: QuickBooks is only an integration of their product
watch_out_for: 'Sync with QuickBooks' on a product page describes their product
Note QuickBooks Enterprise separately; that is a different signal

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Office Manager: maintain books in QuickBooks Online, run payroll in Gusto

output.reason: A job post requires running the company's books in QBO.
